name: Delete a property access control rule
description: Delete a property access control rule Delete a property access control rule. DELETE /api/projects/{project_id}/property_access_controls/
context:
DELETE /api/projects/{project_id}/property_access_controls/
Delete a property access control rule. The rule is identified by `property_definition_id` plus an optional `organization_member` or `role` query parameter. Omitting both targets deletes the default rule.
Required: project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.; property_definition_id (query) — The property definition ID the rule applies to.
Optional: organization_member (query) — The organization member UUID whose override should be deleted.; role (query) — The role UUID whose override should be deleted.
